description: Draws a small inline trend line from a list of numbers, for KPI cards and table rows, in the theme's colours.

inputs.name: Values
inputs.description: The numbers, in order, separated by commas, semicolons or spaces (for example 3,5,2,8). Use a dot for decimals. Fewer than two numbers draw nothing.

inputs.name: Label
inputs.description: What the line shows, read by screen readers (for example Sales, last 7 days). The first and last values are added to it.

inputs.name: ShowLast
inputs.description: Mark the last point with a dot.

modifiers.description: The line in the success colour, for a trend that's good news.
The line in the error colour, for a trend that's bad news.
